title: Seasonal variation and risk assessment for the presence of pharmaceuticals in Brazilian urban rivers
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00828F, Paper
Miraldo Santa Rosa dos Santos, Cristiane Vidal, Vinicius Sarracini Santos, Ramon Domingues, Cassiana Carolina Montagner
A comparative analysis of the occurrence of pharmaceuticals in four water bodies across three Brazilian metropolitan areas shows that the contamination level in water depends on the river basin use and occupation, but is less related to seasonality.
